# Sampler

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Graphics` · enum

```csharp
public enum Sampler
```

How a sprite batch reads its textures: blending neighbouring pixels or taking the nearest (for pixel art), and clamping at the edges or repeating (for tiled backgrounds).

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="linearclamp"></a>`LinearClamp` | Blends neighbouring pixels, and stops at the texture's edges. |
| <a name="pointclamp"></a>`PointClamp` | Takes the nearest pixel, and stops at the texture's edges. |
| <a name="linearrepeat"></a>`LinearRepeat` | Blends neighbouring pixels, and repeats past the texture's edges. |
| <a name="pointrepeat"></a>`PointRepeat` | Takes the nearest pixel, and repeats past the texture's edges. |
